dog.description_text: Churro is a small, scruffy and friendly pup who we rescued after he was brough to the NYPD precient. We are learning more about him as he settles in a home with other dogs! So far he has been friendly, does'nt mind baths or making his little bark heard, he loves walks and getting attention. We estimate his is about 1.5 years old, but will confirm for sure at his vet checkup! He has enjoyed meeting other dogs + people outside, and even went to the store with his foster mom and behaved great in the car and shopping cart! Churro seems like a highly adaptable guy and we can't wait to learn more about him. He will be fully vetted and neutered.
dog.name: Churro
